originalPixelInventory: One tall closed rectangular semiconductor block with dark outer edges and repeated parallel diagonal hatch strokes rising from lower left to upper right.

One separate bowed internal junction boundary, bulging leftward around the insert and returning toward the block's right edge near its upper/lower junction ends; this is not replaced by the hatch strokes.
One dark filled, vertically elongated insert on the block's right side, with tapered upper/lower ends.
Two horizontal terminal leads: a full left lead entering the block at approximately mid-height and a full right lead leaving the dark insert; both outer endpoints are present.

Three complete leader-label groups: an n-form glyph above the block connected to its upper edge, a p-form glyph upper right connected to the dark insert, and the lower-right p-n followed by the visible Chinese junction character, connected toward the lower junction bend.
No axes, ticks, grid, numerical given values or second subfigure appear in this source figure.

completeness.finding: All block edges, diagonal hatching, curved junction line, filled insert, both lead endpoints and all three label/leader groups seen on the original are inside the native PNG; no meaningful stroke is clipped.

pollution.finding: The source caption for227 is below the isolated figure and absent from the crop. No228 body, neighboring caption, incoming112 prose or113 heading is included. The junction label is part of the figure, not neighboring prose.

figures.glyphLimits: n-form and p-form describe visible shapes only; no Latin-versus-Cyrillic script identity is inferred from homographs.

One complete upper terminal: a narrow vertical stem rises from the can's top into an irregular elongated outlined swelling/loop, with the short top tip retained.

No separate leader labels, axes, ticks, circuit wiring or second device occur in the source figure.
